limitations: Page 5 is oblique; footprint boundaries are conservative manual estimates.
Course 6 off-road gravel/bare ground is a separate facility and is excluded from the race circuit.
Farmland and distant woodland outside the large oval are not modelled as adjacent circuit grass/forest.

The source video is a complete dry-handling lap uploaded2022-11-26. Its title supplies the same date; publication and operator brochure year do not independently establish the photo capture date.

Default white edges and short yellow/grey flat paint strips replace the former red-white full-perimeter curbs. Widths, strip block length, asphalt margins, rail offsets/heights and junction endpoints are visual estimates.
The3.4km dry-handling circuit is distinct from the separate4.6km banked oval and training pads. This update does not construct the entire oval, infer its bank angle or pave all land within it.

Random infield trees are disabled. Existing source grass islands and new paved margins are painted on original terrain triangles; the road, elevation, car paths, physics and simulation timing origin remain unchanged.

Video-to-canonical station correspondence uses the turn sequence, with approximately60m uncertainty. Failed brochure-diagram registration and schematic grey fill are not used as measured asphalt boundaries.

Grass reserves use the matching base terrain material. Paved margins and neutral pale verges are terrain-only material masks; the pale verge outline is simplified within0.8m, and its aggregate/concrete composition remains unconfirmed.
